meta.title: Villa Žnjan — Apartments by the sea in Split
meta.description: Five modern apartments in Žnjan, Split — steps from the beach. Book your Adriatic getaway directly with the owners.

hero.title: Your home by the Adriatic
hero.subtitle: Five modern apartments a short stroll from Žnjan beach. Sea views, sunny terraces, and the old town just minutes away.

intro.heading: A relaxed base for your Split holiday
intro.body: Villa Žnjan sits in one of Split's most sought-after seaside neighbourhoods. Whether you're travelling as a couple or a family, each apartment is designed for comfort — fully equipped kitchens, air conditioning, fast Wi‑Fi, and private outdoor space.

units.heading: Our apartments
units.subheading: Five distinct units, each with its own character.

location.heading: The neighbourhood
location.body: Žnjan combines easy beach access with a calm residential feel. You're 10 minutes from Diocletian's Palace, close to cafés and restaurants, and well connected to the airport and ferry port.

contactCta.heading: Questions? Get in touch
contactCta.subheading: Send us a message and we'll reply personally — usually within a few hours.
